config.label: The email address you sign in to war
config.description: The email address you sign in to war.app with.

config.label: Your war
config.description: Your war.app API token, from https://war.app/API/GetAPIToken while signed in.

config.label: fetchproxy bridge concentrator port for the live-game tools
config.description: fetchproxy bridge concentrator port for the live-game tools. Defaults to the fleet-shared 37149.

config.label: Optional dotenv file with WARAPP_EMAIL / WARAPP_API_TOKEN (default ~/
config.description: Optional dotenv file with WARAPP_EMAIL / WARAPP_API_TOKEN (default ~/.config/warapp-mcp/.env)

config.label: How the live-game tools reach war
config.description: How the live-game tools reach war.app: auto (default, direct when a session is linked else the browser bridge), direct, or fetchproxy.

config.label: Where the linked direct-transport session is stored (default <data dir>/session
config.description: Where the linked direct-transport session is stored (default <data dir>/session.json). Local-only, file mode 0600.

config.label: The name-free cross-game record of how other players kept truces (salted hashes, no names)
config.description: The name-free cross-game record of how other players kept truces (salted hashes, no names). On by default; set off to turn it off.

config.label: Opponent profiling: counts of what each opponent did on the turns your boards showed (gameplay only, no names or chat), kept per game, and folded name-free (salted-hash keys) into counts across finished games
config.description: Opponent profiling: counts of what each opponent did on the turns your boards showed (gameplay only, no names or chat), kept per game, and folded name-free (salted-hash keys) into counts across finished games. On by default; set off to turn it off.
